Our story

A local chair
with a global view.

Northline started with a simple idea: the best barbershop is one where the cut is only part of the experience. Since 2018, we've built a space in the heart of Fitzroy for considered craft, good conversation and a little time to yourself.

Our barbers bring years of experience and a belief that style should feel like you — just a little sharper.
